annotations.title: Long-term climate risk of one place: floods, heat, drought, sea level

description:
Long-term climate risk of one place or property in depth, from 57 global layers: river and coastal flood depth of a 100-year flood now, 2050 and 2080; sea level rise; extreme heat and cold days; heavy rain; drought; water stress; wildfire; warming and rainfall change to 2050 and 2080 with the models' range; NDVI vegetation; earthquake hazard, subsidence, elevation, land cover and the climate zone. Narrow it with categories or layer ids (fetch catalog:layers).

Use for buying, renting or building a home or moving somewhere: "does this area flood", "how hot will it get here by 2050". Two or more places, a list of sites or a portfolio: get_climate_table, up to 200 in one call. Not for this week's weather (get_forecast) or events now (get_hazards_near).

categories.description: Only the layers of these categories; every layer when omitted. misc holds Köppen climate zone, now and in 2050 and 2080, solar radiation, solar radiation of the sunniest month, surface runoff; fetch catalog:layers lists every layer

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

layers.description: Only these layers, by id, e.g. ndvi/annual for the NDVI vegetation index or flood_riverine/inundation for river flood depth; fetch catalog:layers lists every id. Combined with categories, both are given

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give
